scope: Pinned MQTT5 OS TCP server, explicit V5 profile; default Both compatibility and two SHOULD exceptions remain qualified. This is finite project acceptance, not certification.

criteria.title: Source completeness
requirements: Review authoritative paragraphs/tables and resolve every applicable unnumbered obligation or leave G1 open.

criteria.title: Endpoint directions
requirements: Review both endpoint roles and exercise legal/invalid packet/property/reason contexts.

criteria.title: Fault recovery
requirements: Run actual SQLite failure/contention and crash-restart barriers against acknowledged state.

criteria.title: Fuzz campaigns
requirements: Run deterministic mutation and coverage-guided targets with exact budgets and no unresolved crashes.

criteria.title: Unified closure
requirements: Pass Rust and client regression, independent review and inventory/reference guards on the final artifact.
